components.name: Canvas Surface
components.description: Warm paper slide on charcoal; apricot empty-frame plus.
components.css: .ds-canvas { width: 240px; height: 300px; background: #f4f1ec; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-frame-plus { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1c1c1c; border: 2px solid #e8a060; position: relative; cursor: pointer; } .ds-frame-plus::before, .ds-frame-plus::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; background: #e8a060; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); } .ds-frame-plus::before { width: 18px; height: 2px; } .ds-frame-plus::after { width: 2px; height: 18px; } .ds-frame-plus:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-frame-plus:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8a060; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
PudduScroll’s interface is a warm, classy desktop tool: charcoal chrome around a cream print surface, with apricot as the only highlight. The mood is refined and restrained. Brand lives in precise details — one accent, flat tonal layers, and quiet motion — not in decoration.

The continuous strip is the stage; the chrome stays out of its way. Menus are squared and native-feeling. Library cards are the softest corners in the system. Anti-references are neon cyber UI, purple SaaS gradients, and Instagram-clone chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Single accent (Apricot Ember) on charcoal; cream paper only for the canvas
Flat tonal depth; shadows reserved for toasts
Square chrome, gently rounded cards and dialogs
Motion small and fast; interaction updates stay immediate

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Apricot Ember is the only highlight. New colors join the warm set in crates/app/src/ui/mod.rs; they do not compete with ACCENT.

rules.name: The Paper-Only Rule
rules.body: Warm Paper is for canvases. Do not use it as app chrome fill.

rules.name: The Locked Scale Rule
rules.body: Reuse 22 / 16 / 14 / 13. Do not invent a fifth size for ordinary chrome.

rules.name: The Chrome Trinity Rule
rules.body: Toolbar, editor, rail. Home cards use card_frame; editor chrome sits flat on Charcoal Void and Charcoal Panel.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat. Shadows appear only for toast feedback, not for cards, panels, or buttons.

rules.name: The Square Chrome Rule
rules.body: Menus and primary tool chrome stay square. Rounding belongs to cards, covers, and dialogs — not to the menu bar.

dos: Do paint with the warm set in ui/mod.rs (BG, PANEL, CANVAS_BG, ACCENT, TEXT, MUTED, SELECT_BG).
Do put black text on apricot fills.
Do name buttons as actions (“Create template”) and empty states as what’s missing (“No templates yet.”).
Do keep hover/open motion in 0.1–0.25s; keep drag, zoom, nudge, and undo on the same frame.
Do route long names through short_name so rows still read with extreme lengths.
donts: Don't introduce neon cyber UI, purple SaaS gradients, or Instagram-clone chrome.
Don't add a second accent color or use Warm Paper as app chrome.
Don't put drop shadows on resting cards, panels, or buttons.
Don't invent type sizes outside 22 / 16 / 14 / 13 for ordinary UI.
Don't round the menu bar or treat the editor as a nested card stack.
